# FAST Channel Engine (`channel-engine`)

Based on VOD2Live Technology you can generate a numerous amounts of FAST channels with a fraction of energy consumption compared to live transcoded FAST channels

[Service documentation](https://docs.osaas.io/osaas.wiki/Service%3A-FAST-Channel-Engine.html) · [Source](https://github.com/Eyevinn/docker-fast)

## Example

```terraform
resource "osc_instance" "example" {
  service_id = "channel-engine"
  name       = "myengine"

  parameters = {
    type                  = "Loop"
    url                   = "..."
    # opts.useDemuxedAudio  = "true"
    # opts.useVttSubtitles  = "true"
    # opts.defaultSlateUri  = "..."
    # opts.langList         = "..."
    # opts.langListSubs     = "..."
    # opts.preset           = "DD"
    # opts.preroll.url      = "..."
    # opts.preroll.duration = "..."
    # opts.webhook.apikey   = "..."
  }
}
```

Commented lines are optional parameters. Values marked `"..."` need a real value. Outputs are `url`, `external_ip`, `external_port` and the raw `instance` document, see the `osc_instance` resource.

## Parameters

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `type` | enum | yes | Plugin type Allowed: `Loop`, `Playlist`, `WebHook`, `Barker`. Default `Loop`. |
| `url` | string | yes | URL of VOD, playlist to loop or WebHook Pattern `^http`. |
| `opts.useDemuxedAudio` | boolean | no | Use demuxed audio Default `true`. |
| `opts.useVttSubtitles` | boolean | no | Use VTT subtitles Default `true`. |
| `opts.defaultSlateUri` | string | no | URI to default slate Pattern `^http`. |
| `opts.langList` | list | no | Comma separated list of languages |
| `opts.langListSubs` | list | no | Comma separated list of subtitle languages |
| `opts.preset` | enum | no | Channel preset Allowed: `DD`, `HEVC`, `ATMOS`. |
| `opts.preroll.url` | string | no | URL to preroll Pattern `^http`. |
| `opts.preroll.duration` | string | no | Duration of preroll in milliseconds Pattern `^[0-9]+$`. |
| `opts.webhook.apikey` | string | no | WebHook api key |

Parameter values are strings; booleans take `"true"` or `"false"`. Reference an `osc_secret` as `osc_secret.<name>.ref` to keep a value out of the instance configuration. This page is generated from the OSC catalog; the provider validates against the live catalog when planning.
